summary.what_it_does: The page is the introduction to a USENIX ;login: article on BeyondCorp, Google's enterprise security approach. It argues that firewall-based perimeter security is weak because a breach gives an attacker relatively easy access to a privileged intranet. It states that Google is removing the requirement for a privileged intranet and moving its corporate applications onto the Internet. The visible text is only this short excerpt, so the full article's technical details are not included here.
notable: Google moves corporate applications from a privileged intranet to the Internet
